sample1_text: It could perhaps be argued that the results, whilst promising, do not yet constitute conclusive evidence. There may be several confounding factors we have not fully accounted for, and it is possible that a larger sample would reveal a somewhat different pattern. I would tentatively suggest that further investigation is warranted before any firm conclusions are drawn, though I remain uncertain as to which direction that investigation should take.
sample2_completions: This does not, I think, quite meet what was asked for, though it is possible I am reading the brief too narrowly, I would want to check before saying more.
I suppose I try to understand things carefully enough that other people do not have to, though that is perhaps a generous way of putting it.
I have, tentatively, decided that we should delay the rollout, though I remain somewhat uncertain whether that is the right call.
